- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Kathryn is an Engineer, so not the owner.

If full-time: maximum is write. Requested write ≤ write → grant write.
If contractor with basic training: maximum is read. Requested write > read → grant read.
